notes: Independent check agrees with ineligible/internal (E2 step 2). Verified this session: (1) issue #2083 body contains the escalation log (SIGINT->SIGTERM at '5' s, SIGTERM->SIGKILL at '10.0' s) and the launch-file excerpt; (2) mjcarroll comments verified verbatim: 'I now have a minimal reproduction example using a component with a single timer and publication' and 'In the isolated case, we end up blocking on a `sem_wait` and the semaphore never gets posted to because `Signalhandler::uninstall` never seems to get called.'; (3) dujeong comment verified: 'I also had the same problem when using non-Nav2 component' — failure occurs with any loaded component; (4) pre-fix code comment verified at 37adc03c in component_manager_isolated.hpp: '// We rely on the assumption that this class creates executors and then immediately makes them / spin in a separate thread' with the wait loop 'while (!executor_wrapper.executor->is_spinning())'; (5) PR #2085 merged 2023-01-23 as ab71df3ce1d8993e8424e7d0934b2e205284c682; clalancette ABI comment verified ('the addition of the `atomic_bool` to the inner struct definitely breaks ABI'); mjcarroll's 'under-documentation in the way that the executor's cancel works' verified verbatim in the PR #2085 comments; (6) PR #3282 '[Humble] Fix isolated component manager shutdown hang' merged 2026-09-22 as cfdb3b7dcea4a503c0acaa304d033636beeb1dba. The hang is the container's own infinite wait loop after context shutdown made spin() return; the executor (rclcpp) behaves as designed and any correct executor/loaded component produces the same hang, so E2 stops at step 2. Loudness/resolution null is schema-correct for an ineligible case ('other fields null' per S1); had it been eligible, the escalation ERROR log quoted above would be the closest diagnostic evidence, and the two merged PRs (both changing only cancel_executor's body) the resolution.
